syllabus_extract: Video demonstrating fluid flow characteristics. Video on theory of flight
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review video segments; Instructor supervises note-taking on flow patterns and boundary layer separation.
intro_questions: What are the basic properties of the atmosphere?
How does fluid flow behave over a solid body?

development.content:
Atmospheric properties and density
Viscosity and fluid behavior
Flow over bodies and streamlines
Bernoulli's principle application
Pressure distribution on surfaces

Boundary layer formation and growth
Laminar and turbulent flow characteristics
Separation points and wake formation
Effect of surface roughness
Reynolds number significance

Flow visualization techniques
Impact of angle of attack
Drag generation mechanisms
Lift generation basics
Connection to helicopter flight

summary_questions: Explain how the boundary layer affects lift generation.
Describe the difference between laminar and turbulent flow.
How does fluid flow change when separation occurs?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of fluid flow discussed in this lesson apply to the rotor blades covered in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Factors affecting CL, Theories of Lift production, force and pitching moment, coefficient of lift, variation of co-efficient of lift with aspect ratio and sweep back and CL.
